name: Scroll Layout Galleries
description: Long dark page of nine pinned image galleries that morph between layouts as you scroll (row, grid, dense grid, stacks, tiny grid, bento, single frame), separated by short text sections.
contents: Intro block with project label, name, date, large title and mission paragraphs
Nine pinned galleries with captions built from the images array
Optional row of related study cards
behavior: Each gallery pins and morphs from one layout to another with GSAP Flip scrubbed by scroll
Smooth scrolling through Lenis, switchable by prop
Images inside some tiles scale down during the transition
Captions fade and move in as the layout resolves
editableByProps: Images, all intro, section and caption text, cards
Colors, radii, scroll distances, stagger and smooth scroll

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which layout each gallery uses or their order
needsCodeEdit.where: config array inside the useEffect and the gallery blocks in the returned JSX
css string built before the return

needsCodeEdit.change: Change number of images per gallery
needsCodeEdit.where: pick function calls in the JSX

fixed: Nine galleries with fixed layouts and order
Galleries pin the page during scroll and Lenis smooth scrolling takes over page scroll when enabled, destroyed on unmount
Large vertical spacers between galleries are needed for the pinned scroll range
Layouts use viewport units and are designed for full-width placement
